correctness.rationale: Exact projection of a solid tube around a circle is radius-r planar tube around ellipse of axes R,Rc (c=|u_z|), outer offset minus inner erosion. Its inradius b=Rc determines hole threshold c=s=r/R; curvature rolling radius min b²/a determines no-normal-overlap threshold c=√s. Steiner/coarea and monotone perimeter give strict area loss below 2rP for c<√s; Haar c uniform on [0,1] gives three regime probabilities and unique overlap maximum 1/4. Inward ellipse offset near minor-axis incenter gives H(c)~R²(8/3)sqrt(2(1−s²)/s)(c−s)^(3/2), hence hole distribution onset 2/3. Independently buffered 12k-vertex ellipse polygons for three ratios and checked finite-δ asymptotic; analysis is general, polygon buffering is not.
